data.body:
Landed and closed.

Merged as `5e29bbf8be76fed3058a48f68eb1ef9b42b662a5` via Gerrit change 3133 — 6 files, 22 insertions, 131 deletions. Both gates green on patch set 1 (`LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, 0 unresolved); `mergeable: true` confirmed before a revision-scoped submit. The merged SHA equals the pushed SHA because the branch was pre-rebased, leaving nothing for Gerrit to do. Ticket closed with `--ref 5e29bbf8be76fed3058a48f68eb1ef9b42b662a5`; all 7 ACs ticked.

**The predicted release-notes conflict materialised and was pre-empted.** When rebased onto the WORKFLOWS commit `76a3cbac755`, this branch hit the same `docs/release-notes.md` conflict that cost change 3132 a second gate cycle — both slices insert a section immediately after the same fixed preamble. Because the rebase was done *before* the first push rather than after a failed submit, it cost no approvals: patch set 1 carried the resolved file and went straight through. Resolution kept both sections with the newest-landing one on top. Pre-push re-verification was scoped to the delta: `ruff check` plus the touched eval modules and the docs-drift modules that read `docs/release-notes.md` (115 passed).

Dependency status: this ticket is one of three blockers on the ENGINE slice (`43bd`). `8c31` (REPOINT) is still open at Gerrit 3134, so `43bd` correctly remains blocked — the close reported `unblocked: none`.
